lessons.advice: When extending inverse-trigonometric LaTeX formatting, inspect the function-name dispatch table and test each added function with the requested style. The observed acsc output comes from agent-edited code, not a source-revision check.

assumptions.statement: The inspected inverse-trig style dispatch table contains asin, acos, atan and acot, but omits acsc and asec.
After the agent adds acsc to the table, latex(acsc(x), inv_trig_style="full") emits an operator named arccsc.
assumptions.workspace_context: Checkout after the table edit in message 4.
